battlefield.gauntlet: Six Territory Cards arranged in one column.
battlefield.starting_position: Each Player Token begins on the Territory at that player's own end of the Gauntlet. Setup placement is not movement and does not count as entering.
battlefield.capture: During Capture, if your token is on or beyond the next opposing Territory immediately beyond your Front Line, add that Territory to your Front Line. Normal Capture advances the Front Line by at most one Territory per turn. Capturing the Territory at the opponent's end immediately runs the Gauntlet and wins.
battlefield.victory: Run the Gauntlet and win immediately by either capturing the Territory at the opponent's end or winning the opponent's Last Stand.

last_stand.text: The defender normally has Defensive Edge and separately adds +1 to their battle total.
last_stand.access: After the opponent is forced beyond their own end, an attacker on the opponent's final Territory may initiate the Last Stand by using a separate legal movement sequence to Advance beyond that end.

battlefield.front_line: The unbroken sequence of Territories a player controls from their own end. Control cannot skip an opposing Territory, although a Player Token may move beyond its Front Line.

battle.defensive_edge: When the defender has Defensive Edge, the defender wins tied battle totals. The defender normally has it while controlling the contested Territory or making a Last Stand, unless an effect removes it.
battle.tiebreak_roll: Each player rolls one die. Do not apply advantage, disadvantage, card effects, numerical modifiers, or previous battle totals. Higher roll wins; reroll further ties.
battle.withdrawal: Withdrawal ends or prevents a pending or active battle without a winner. Before Onset there is no battle or Aftermath. After Onset, complete remaining non-result Aftermath steps and clear committed cards normally.
battle.retreat: A losing player retreats. Retreat follows a battle result and applies normal win, loss, Occupation, and result effects.

territories.name: Smuggler's Run
territories.text:
During Opening or Denouement, as an Action, while occupying and controlling Smuggler's Run, a player may stash one card from their Hand face down beneath it. The stashed card does not count toward the Hand limit.
While that player occupies and controls Smuggler's Run, they may play the stashed card for its Action effect or set it as a Gambit as though it were in their Hand, if eligible. It counts as a card played or set from Hand.
At the start of the stashing player's turn, if they control Smuggler's Run, they may return the stashed card to their Hand. If they lose control of Smuggler's Run, put the stashed card in its owner's Discard Pile. Only one card may be stashed here.

proposals.name: De-escalation
proposals.accepted: Both players withdraw. The accepting player draws one card.

proposals.name: Orderly Withdrawal
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be the attacker.
proposals.accepted: The Diplomat withdraws. The accepting player remains at the contested Position, then draws one card.
proposals.refused: Add +1 to the Diplomat's battle total.

proposals.name: Capitulation
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be the defender.
proposals.accepted: The Diplomat withdraws. The accepting player remains at the contested Position and becomes the occupier when applicable, then draws one card.
proposals.refused: If the Diplomat loses, the Diplomat draws two cards.

proposals.name: Open Channels
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must have a card in Hand.
proposals.accepted: Both players reveal their Hands, then both players withdraw. The accepting player draws one card.
proposals.refused: The refusing player reveals their Hand. When the Diplomat forms their Reserve, the Diplomat draws one additional card.

proposals.name: Mutual Disarmament
proposals.requirement: Both players must have a card in Hand.
proposals.accepted: Each player discards one card from Hand. The accepting player draws one card, then both players withdraw.
proposals.refused: The Diplomat may discard one card from Hand. If they do, the Diplomat draws one additional card when forming their Reserve.

proposals.name: Prisoner Exchange
proposals.requirement: Each player must have a card in their Graveyard.
proposals.accepted: Each player may move one card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile. Then both players withdraw.
proposals.refused: If the Diplomat loses, the Diplomat may move one card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile.

proposals.name: Rebuilding Pact
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must have a card in Hand that can be banked as an Asset.
proposals.accepted: Each player may bank one eligible card from Hand as an Asset without taking an Action. Then both players withdraw.
proposals.refused: During the Aftermath, the Diplomat may bank one eligible card from Hand as an Asset without taking an Action.

proposals.name: Ultimatum
proposals.accepted: The accepting player withdraws. The Diplomat remains at the contested Position and becomes the occupier when applicable.
proposals.refused: Add +1 to the Diplomat's battle total.

proposals.name: Diplomatic Recognition
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be defending a Counterattack while occupying a Territory the opposing player controlled immediately before the Diplomat became its occupier.
proposals.accepted: The Diplomat advances their Front Line by one Territory, if able. The accepting player withdraws, then draws two cards.
proposals.refused: If the Diplomat wins, advance the Diplomat's Front Line by one Territory during the Aftermath, if able. The Diplomat gains no Influence for imposing this Proposal.

numeric_shorthand.reserve: +N Reserve adds N cards to the Reserve at the stated timing; during Reserve formation it modifies the normal Reserve size.
numeric_shorthand.tactic: +N Tactic permits N additional Tactics; the default source is Reserve and a different source is printed only when it overrides that default.
numeric_shorthand.negative_reserve: −N Reserve reduces the Reserve by N at the stated timing, subject to any printed minimum.

compact_shorthand.cards: +N Card(s) draws N cards from your Draw Pile into your Hand unless another player or destination is stated.
compact_shorthand.actions: +N Action grants N additional Actions in the current phase unless another phase is stated.
compact_shorthand.resources: +N Capital / Influence / Command / Conviction gains that amount; costs and losses remain verbal.
compact_shorthand.battle_total: +N Battle Total adds N to your battle total.
compact_shorthand.retreat: Retreat +N increases the identified retreat by N Positions.
compact_shorthand.advantage: Advantage / Double Advantage / Disadvantage are direct instructions.
compact_shorthand.set_value: Resource = N sets that resource to N.
compact_shorthand.front_line: Advance Front Line N advances the Front Line by N Territories.
compact_shorthand.prefixes: Attacker — / Defender — / Counterattack — / Win — / Lose — scope the following clause.
compact_shorthand.rerolls: A reroll replaces the result it rerolls; the new result is used unless an effect says otherwise.

advantage_wording.rule: Card faces use gain advantage / gain double advantage / gain disadvantage wording while the underlying instance-based stacking rule remains unchanged.

advantage_capitalization.rule: Advantage and Disadvantage are defined game terms and are capitalized in player-facing text; double remains a normal modifier.

asset_language.removed_term: An Asset is Removed when it is forced to leave play. Natural destination verbs may cause Removal without using the keyword.
asset_language.asset_limit: Discarding an Asset because the Asset limit decreased counts as Removal.
asset_language.exclusions: Voluntary discard/use and normal self-expiration do not count as Removal.
asset_language.ownership_style: Use your Assets / opposing Assets / their Assets instead of redundant Asset you control language when ownership is already clear.

gambit_tactic_heading.rendering: Card faces stack the label as Gambit/ over Tactic; the line break is presentation only.
gambit_tactic_heading.prose: Use Gambit effect, Tactic effect, or Gambit or Tactic effect as the sentence requires. Never use Gambit/Tactic as a prose effect category.

territory_arrangement.timing: After opening selection and before the first-player roll.

starting_position.text: Each Player Token begins on the Territory at that player's own end of the Gauntlet.

initiative.timing: After both players complete opening selection and Territory arrangement.
initiative.method: Each player rolls one die; higher result takes the first turn; reroll ties.

effect_headings.gambit_tactic_default_timing: A Gambit/Tactic, Gambit, or Tactic effect with no later printed timing applies at that role's normal reveal stage.

inherent_bank_action.text: Bank: As an Action, play this card from your Hand and bank it.

directly_permitted_card_procedures.exception: An instruction that expressly identifies an Action still uses the applicable Action permission.

sanctions.default_expiration: After that opponent later accepts the owner's Terms, put the Sanction in its owner's Discard Pile.

bind.default_host_departure_destination: Bound cards go to their owners' Discard Piles unless an effect gives another destination.
bind.excess_bound_cards_after_limit_reduction: Choose and discard excess bound cards immediately until the limit is satisfied.

reveal_stage_interference.scope: Effects that reveal, negate, return, discard, replace, or otherwise prevent another Gambit or Tactic at that reveal stage from applying normally.
